title: Concresoil
description: Akim of Sumeru City seems to be having some new ideas regarding commonly used soils...

mainQuestExcel.title: Concresoil
mainQuestExcel.description: Akim of Sumeru City seems to be having some new ideas regarding commonly used soils...

dialogs.text: Isn't there a better material...
What material?
Sorry, I was talking to myself again. The fickle weather's been causing all sorts of problems with houses. I've never been this busy.
Aren't you a potter?
Yeah, but I'm also a bricklayer. You see, it's all about the soil in either case. Not much of a difference.
Have you heard that saying? "Learning is like building a house. If you want to build a tall one, you must lay a solid foundation."
"And if you want to expand your knowledge, you need to ensure that your foundations are solid. A shifting foundation will only lead to collapse..."
Those smart higher-ups always say so. I don't really get it, but it's clear to me that they regard building houses to be as important as learning!
They're just using a figure of speech...
Anyway, when you think of a house's foundations, you think of building materials.
Soil is the binding and support material, so if its stability and adaptability can be increased, our houses will be more durable. And I won't have to be this busy anymore.
I don't think that's how you interpret it.
I've come up with a few ideas, and today, I'm planning to find some soil soaked in Slime Condensate.
I've found out about a place where Slimes gather. Can you head there and find me some soil?
Leave it to me.
I'll leave it to you then. It doesn't matter if you take those Slimes down or not. Just bring some of the soil near them back.
I'll mark the place on the map for you...
Not coming along?
I would love to, but I still have some pottery to handle.
Don't worry. I'll take care of the payment. Thanks a lot!
I'll mark the place on the map for you, so please head there and look for it.
I'll leave it to you then. It doesn't matter if you take those Slimes down or not. Just bring some of the soil near them back.
I've come up with a few ideas, and today... I'm planning to find some soil that is constantly exposed to elemental creatures.
Whopperflowers will be a good option. The soil where such creatures grow may have distinctive features.
But I'm just a bricklayer, and well, hitting Whopperflowers with a brick is hardly going to help me get a hold of that soil...
So, Traveler, could you help me do this?
Sure.
Thank you. And don't forget, we're looking for soil where Whopperflowers grow!
I know a place where Whopperflowers appear, or so it is said.
Not coming along?
I would love to, but I still have some pottery to handle.
Don't worry. I'll take care of the payment. Thanks a lot!
I'll mark the place on the map for you, so please head there and look for it.
Thank you. And don't forget, we're looking for soil where Whopperflowers grow!
I've come up with a few ideas, and I'm planning to find some moist soil today.
With adequate moisture and strong adhesion, it should be perfect for fixing cracks.
Leave it to me.
It would be great if you could help. I will mark the location on your map. Please go look for it...
Topsoil is not gonna work, so you'll have to dig deeper. I'm counting on you!
Not coming along?
I would love to, but I still have some pottery to handle.
Don't worry. I'll take care of the payment. Thanks a lot!
I'll mark the place on the map for you, so please head there and look for it.
Ordinary topsoil is not gonna work, so you'll need to dig deeper.

dialogs.text: Did you get the soil?
Have you found the soil that I need?
That's exactly what I want. You're a great help!
This soil is sticky to the touch. Is this because there's some Slime Condensate mixed in it? I wonder if this can be mixed together with other soil types...
Anyway, thank you for your help, and please take your payment.
Oh, perhaps we should call it "Concresoil" or something...
This is exactly what I'm looking for. You're a great help! I'll start some experiments with this later.
Thank you so much. Please take this as your reward.
If I can mix different soils together, will the mixture be more durable...?
Yes, this is exactly what I want. You're a great help!
Hmm... It's softer than I expected. The adhesion is fine, but it doesn't provide enough support...
It's okay, though. As those wise folk put it, "No tall building was built in a day."
I suppose creating the kind of soil I want couldn't be that easy either...
Thank you so much. Please take this as your payment.
I'll try some other options later.
